name: Critical hits
description: Gameplay change (off by default; Other Empires page, Gameplay changes). A hit that damages an engine, a reactor or a command centre / targeting computer has a chance (30% by default) to be critical, with a lasting effect on that ship until it is repaired: a critical engine hit slows the ship (30% a hit), a critical reactor hit makes every weapon fire more slowly (+35% between shots a hit), a critical command hit spoils its aim (20% of its hits a hit turn to misses). Effects stack up to 3 times. They end when the damaged part is repaired (or the whole ship is, at a dock). The ship panel shows 'Critical: engines, reactor'. A ship that is hurt weighs a losing fight more heavily: AI fleets withdraw sooner and send crippled ships to repair first.
